digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler subtree comment triage and documentation consolidation
propositions: Comment inventory over rebar_reconciler subtree (95 files, 27k LOC, 42% density) must be triaged: relocated to ADRs/external docs or deleted, with do_not_move list recorded before any edits land.
Stale/false comments must be corrected (e.g., _backend_registry.py STUB header contradicted by select_backend's 13-module usage; S3/S4-not-landed notes in _backend.py and adapters/jira/backend.py)

Four new ADRs (field-convergence fit-then-normalize, pagination-stall abort contract, unmapped relations handling, core value-map ownership) must be created and committed before any citations to them are collapsed from comments.
Measured-fact and anti-refactor invariants documented in comments cannot be re-derived from code and must be preserved verbatim or moved to single-source destinations, never lost.

Actual recoverable line count must be measured and recorded on ticket; initial ~970-line estimate is unreliable and was based on inflated marker counts (28 sites claimed but only ~12 actual occurrences across 10 files).
No behaviour change: reconciler tests must pass unchanged after all relocations and deletions are complete.
